decision: User decision (tapeout-plan.md tier 1 "Pad ESD"): for the release/stress conflict choose the variant that survives stress and accept reduced swing or bandwidth.

selection.name: stress-safe foundation: canonical isolated-rail network + 100 kohm clamp-gate discharge + 3 x 12000 um diode-connected nfet_06v0 rail shunt

configuration.primary: per pad: 4 x diode_pd2nw_06v0 (22.5 um2) PAD->ESD_RAIL, 4 x diode_nd2ps_06v0 (22.5 um2) VSS->PAD (unchanged)
configuration.rc_clamp: native-derived GF_NI_DVDD clamp, 80 x 50 um nfet_06v0 L0.7, 2 MIM, physical ~10 Mohm bleed (unchanged)
configuration.release_fix: 100 kohm clamp gate to VSS, 8 x ppolyf_u_1k 1 x 12.5 um (required; see stress-safe-native-clamp-check.json)
configuration.stress_shunt: 3 series banks, each 240 x 50 um nfet_06v0 L0.7 diode-connected (gate=drain), bodies VSS; v2 wiring (full-width metal2+metal3 plates, 30 um straps) per rail_shunt_v2.py; one per isolated rail (pad pair)

result.description: gate discharge + 3-stage diode-connected nfet_06v0 series stack, 12000 um per stage (50 um x L0.7 fingers), ESD_RAIL->VSS
result.decision: SELECTED: below the 6.0 V screen at all seven stress corners; costs bounded DC loading near 3.3 V

selection.capacitance_note: Shunt hangs on the isolated rail behind the steering diodes; with the rail as AC ground (upper bound) it adds 0 F to the pad. Primary diode capacitance is unchanged at 0.169-0.181 pF per pad.

criterion.stress: Observed PAD-facing MOS gate-terminal voltages below the PDK DC screens (6.0 V nfet/pfet_06v0, 3.63 V 03v3; spec/schematic-implementation.json gate_voltage_screen) for the 100 mA / 2 ns diagnostic at tt/ss/ff x 0/85C plus tt/27C (safety range)
criterion.function: DC loading per driven pad at tt/ss/ff x 22/32C plus tt/27C, pad 1.65-3.35 V (functional window); reported, not gated (decision accepts reduced swing)
criterion.safety: Brownout retained-fixture loading and DC loading at 3.63 V, 85C and ss/0C: must be bounded, into VSS only

stimulus: 100 mA positive, 0.1 ns edges, 2 ns flat into PAD_P at 1000 ns, VDD=1.5 V brownout after 1 us; retained 3.3 V / 1.5 kohm / 15 kohm board peers, 1 ohm + 1 nH bond, 10 pF board

fixture.description: retained RX/USB extracted pad (all attachments), board peers, long brownout; only the named rail devices added

recorded_unchanged_clamp.description: Canonical native-derived RC clamp as laid out (no gate discharge)

stress.note: Passes only because the clamp starts stuck partly on (gate ~0.76 V). From a released start (ss/0C) it reaches 8.29 V with 98 observed exceedances (stress-safe-native-clamp-check.json).

recorded_unchanged_clamp.release: Fails: brownout pad held at 1.554 V with 1.06 mA into the isolated rail; active-window pad dips to ~1.96 V at tt/27C (inside the functional window).
recorded_unchanged_clamp.decision: rejected: stress result depends on an undefined stuck state; loads pads inside the functional window

recorded_gate_discharge.source: rail-supervisor-screen.json:protection_release_pulse.True; rerun across corners as released_baseline; tt/27C reproduces the recorded 8.099 V peak
recorded_gate_discharge.description: Canonical clamp + 100 kohm gate discharge (8 x ppolyf_u_1k 1x12.5 um, schematic)
recorded_gate_discharge.decision: rejected: releases correctly, fails stress at every corner (7.78-8.65 V, 98 observed exceedances)

recorded_direct_trigger.description: gate discharge + three diode-connected 100 um 6V NMOS rail-to-gate trigger
recorded_direct_trigger.decision: rejected: exceeds the 6.0 V screen at tt/27C

recorded_feedforward.description: gate discharge + 4 pF MIM rail-to-gate feed-forward
recorded_feedforward.decision: rejected: exceeds the 6.0 V screen at tt/27C

recorded_static_shunt_3x1000.description: gate discharge + 3 series banks of 20 x 50 um diode-connected 6V NMOS
recorded_static_shunt_3x1000.decision: rejected: exceeds the 6.0 V screen at tt/27C

stack2_w2000.description: gate discharge + 2-stage diode-connected nfet_06v0 series stack, 2000 um per stage (50 um x L0.7 fingers), ESD_RAIL->VSS
stack2_w2000.decision: rejected: most stress margin (<=5.44 V) but 7-17 mA per pad at 3.0-3.3 V even at tt; loads 1.65 V +/- 1 V reference peaks

stack3_w6000.decision: rejected: 6.37 V at ss/0C and 6.32 V at ss/85C (18 observed exceedances)

stack3_w9000.description: gate discharge + 3-stage diode-connected nfet_06v0 series stack, 9000 um per stage (50 um x L0.7 fingers), ESD_RAIL->VSS

diode_area_x2.source: scratch sweep (pad-stress-safe-sweep2), not in final report
diode_area_x2.description: doubled primary steering diodes without shunt
diode_area_x2.cost: +0.17 pF per pad at 1 GHz (0.169 -> 0.339 pF at 1.65 V)
diode_area_x2.decision: rejected: diode drop is not the limiting term; with stack3_w6000 it lowered the peak only 0.12-0.15 V

txpad (wired TX).signal: TMDS/CML into 50 ohm board pull-ups to 3.3 V; high level up to the die rail
txpad (wired TX).cost: Added pad C at 1 GHz: 0 (rail-side shunt). DC load per leg at 3.3 V: 0.31-0.44 mA tt, 18-29 uA ss, 4.2-5.2 mA ff (6.3 mA at 3.35 V ff/32C) -> high-level droop on a 50 ohm pull-up <=22 mV tt, <=0.32 V ff; differential swing preserved to first order, common mode lowered.
txpad (wired TX).fallback: Plan tier 2 "Equalizer / termination": on-chip termination off with board resistors (board pull-up/termination chosen for reduced common mode, or AC-coupled lane). WTX_EXT shares the same pad and does not cover this loss.

wirepad (wired RX/USB).signal: USB FS 0-3.3 V, USB HS 0.4 V, TMDS sink 2.8-3.3 V, generic input range 0-3.6 V
wirepad (wired RX/USB).cost: Same DC load as txpad at 3.0-3.35 V; FS high level loaded up to ~5-6 mA at ff (VOH droop through the ~40 ohm FS driver ~0.2-0.25 V); HS and <=2.5 V signals unaffected (<=0.1 mA ff, <=6 uA tt at 2.5 V). Inputs above 3.35 V (to 3.63 V) draw up to 17 mA at ff/32C.
wirepad (wired RX/USB).fallback: Plan tier 2 USB HS/FS: external board PHY; equalizer/termination: board resistors.

refpad (differential reference).signal: 1.65 V common mode, source up to 1.0 V differential peak (single-ended peaks to ~2.65 V)
refpad (differential reference).cost: No added pad C. Peak loading at 2.65 V: <=~10 uA tt, ~0.1-0.4 mA ff (top of the swing compressed at ff). Below ~2.2 V (<=0.55 V peak) <10 uA at all window corners.
refpad (differential reference).fallback: Reduce source amplitude to <=0.55 V peak; plan tier 2 RF synthesizer second fallback: independent AUX_CLK debug pair (same foundation, same limit).

rfpad (RF RX).signal: small-signal LNA input around its bias (bias level not yet fixed by a transistor-level LNA)
rfpad (RF RX).cost: No added pad capacitance or series resistance, so no bandwidth/NF change from the shunt. Loading <1 uA up to 1.65 V and <0.1 mA up to 2.5 V across the window; an LNA bias above ~2.1 V would be loaded at ff.
rfpad (RF RX).fallback: Plan tier 2 RF RX front end: LNA bypass switch into the mixers with an external board LNA.

rftxpad (RF TX).signal: 0 dBm target = 0.32 V peak into 50 ohm around the driver bias
rftxpad (RF TX).cost: No added pad C. Output peaks above ~2.1 V (ff) / ~2.6 V (tt) are loaded and clipped (10 uA onset), limiting maximum output if the driver idles near VDD.
rftxpad (RF TX).fallback: Plan tier 2 RF TX output: low-power mixer output through the same pad to an external board PA.

generic digital/host.fallback: Plan tier 2 host link: SDR/reduced rate, SPI capture/playback.

layout.v1_withdrawn: The earlier v1 shunt (rail_shunt_layout.py) and everything built on it (stress-safe-foundation/, the first RF composite and ESD_TEST) were withdrawn: its last-bank VSS return ran through 0.23 um guard-ring metal1 (~79 ohm), 4 um metal2 buses (~6.6 ohm end to end) and 1 um metal3 risers (~5.2 ohm). Device-level extraction hid this.
layout.wiring_resistance_check: Distributed wiring model of the drawn v2 macro raises the retained-fixture peak from 5.822 V (device-only) to 5.873 V (nominal sheet/via resistance) and 5.895 V (high corner) at ss/0C: margin 0.105 V to the 6.0 V screen. Network-internal and pad-route resistances are still not included.
layout.strap_capacity: Macro v2.1 (metal4 VSS base 63 um, metal5 overlay from y=290): worst 0.50 of the DRM 85C limit in the 57.2 mA ideal-source fault, 0.12 at 13.4 mA. With DRM values v2 would have been 0.91, not the 1.9x of the earlier assumed limit.

exclusions: Not ESD qualification: 100 mA/2 ns compact-model diagnostic, not HBM/CDM/TLP; no snapback, thermal, current-density or electromigration model; 2 kV HBM / 500 V CDM targets are unverified
Only the positive PAD_P pulse in the retained RX/USB fixture; negative pulses, PAD_N, pad-to-pad and other families were not re-simulated with the shunt
Terminal audit observes 88 of 1077 MOS fully; 989 are partly or not observed (internal nodes unknown)
Shunt buses/vias are not discharge-current or EM qualified
Powered-host backfeed (~81.6 mA), autonomous disable and supervisor gaps are unaffected by this selection
Functional loading uses one pad driven through its primary diodes with the released 4000 um clamp; the RC trigger and second pad are not modelled in that DC check
Selected margin with drawn v2 wiring: 5.873/5.895 V vs 6.0 V at ss/0C (network-internal routing resistance excluded)
Strap EM limits are assumptions (no EM table in the installed PDK)
